subject: Mathematics
objective: Connect a point moving on a unit circle to the height of the sine function.
learner: Knows right-triangle sine but not the circular interpretation.
misconceptions: Sine is only a triangle ratio
requiredInteraction: Change angle and predict a checkpoint.

subject: Mathematics
objective: Show how the slope of a secant line approaches the tangent slope as h shrinks.
learner: Can compute slopes but not interpret a point derivative.
misconceptions: Slope at a point needs two points
requiredInteraction: Change h and inspect the secant.

subject: Mathematics
objective: Compare a function with its first few Taylor polynomials near a point.

subject: Physics
objective: Connect horizontal constant velocity and vertical acceleration to a parabolic trajectory.
misconceptions: Horizontal velocity is zero at the top
correctnessCriteria: x = vx t; y = y0+vy t−g t²/2

subject: Physics
objective: Show kinetic and potential energy exchanging during a pendulum swing.
misconceptions: Both energies are maximum at the bottom
correctnessCriteria: KE max at bottom; PE max at top

subject: Computer Science
objective: Show how larger elements move right and the sorted suffix grows each pass.
requiredInteraction: Step through passes or compare two arrays.

subject: Computer Science
objective: Show that each step preserves the target inside the active interval.
misconceptions: The interval can exclude the target
requiredInteraction: Choose a target or step the search.

subject: Computer Science
objective: Show DFS visiting a branch deeply before backtracking.
correctnessCriteria: No claim that DFS finds shortest path

subject: Economics
objective: Show a binding price ceiling creating shortage without shifting supply or demand.

subject: Economics
objective: Show total revenue moving differently under elastic and inelastic demand when price changes.

subject: Statistics
objective: Show sample means becoming more normal and less variable as sample size grows.
correctnessCriteria: Distribution of means not raw data
No exact-normal claim for finite n

subject: Biology
objective: Connect ion permeability changes to depolarization and repolarization.

subject: Language Learning
objective: Help a learner infer politeness and implicature from indirect requests.
requiredInteraction: Choose an interpretation and explain evidence.
correctnessCriteria: No single fixed answer without evidence
No claim that indirectness is deception
accessibility: text-first; audio transcript; no animation required

subject: Literature
objective: Help a learner explain how a metaphor shapes tone rather than merely decorating text.
correctnessCriteria: No claim of one correct feeling

subject: Chemistry
objective: Show how a concentration change shifts an equilibrium and why the shift counteracts the disturbance.
misconceptions: Adding reactant always increases product yield indefinitely
correctnessCriteria: Equilibrium constant not simply a ratio of rates
